title: DTEP-S Redemption Event
description: Schema for cryptographically signed delivery evidence artifacts generated by Verifier devices under the Digital Transaction Evidence Protocol — Social Layer (DTEP-S). Every event is signed within the Verifier's Trusted Execution Environment after successful Holder verification.

@context.description: JSON-LD context. Must include W3C VC v2 and DTEP-S context URIs.

type.description: Event type. Must include VerifiablePresentation and DTEPRedemptionEvent.

id.description: Globally unique event identifier. Generated fresh for every event. Must never be reused.

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 datetime with timezone. Set by Verifier device clock within TEE. Not modifiable after signing.

holder.description: credentialSubject.id from the presented credential. Pseudonymous — real identity not required.

verifier.description: Identifies the Verifier device and its accreditation.

id.description: Verifier DID. Resolves to Verifier device public key.

accreditationId.description: Verifier accreditation identifier within the scheme declared in the credential allowedVerifiers.

deviceId.description: Opaque stable device identifier for anomaly detection. Must not be a hardware serial number or PII-linked identifier.

credentialRef.description: Reference to the presented credential. Enables Auditor validation without requiring full credential re-presentation.

entitlementType.description: credentialSubject.entitlement.type from presented credential. Copied verbatim — not interpreted by protocol.

issuerRef.description: credentialSubject.entitlement.issuerRef from presented credential. Enables Issuer-side lookup.

credentialHash.description: SHA-256 hash of canonical credential JSON-LD. Hex-encoded. Enables integrity check without storing full credential.

verification.description: Declares how the Holder was verified. Set within TEE. Part of signed payload — cannot be modified after signing.

path.description: The presentation path used for Holder verification.

assuranceLevel.description: Assurance level derived from path. biometric → HIGH. qr-pin → MEDIUM. documentary → LOW.

teeAttestation.description: Present only when path is biometric. TEE-generated attestation proving signing occurred within secure enclave after successful biometric match. Platform-specific format.

pinAttempts.description: Present only when path is qr-pin. Number of PIN attempts before success.

documentType.description: Present only when path is documentary. Issuer-defined document type string.

delivery.description: Records what was delivered. Issuer-defined parameters determine meaningful content beyond required fields.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 datetime of delivery. Must not precede generatedAt by more than Issuer-defined delivery window.

extensions.description: Issuer-defined delivery parameters. No schema constraints.

type.description: Location type. verifierPremises preferred — avoids recording Holder movement patterns.

value.description: Location value. Not required when type is verifierPremises.

deliveryItem.description: A single item in the delivery.

type.description: Issuer-defined item type string. Protocol does not validate correspondence with entitlement type — Auditor responsibility.

unit.description: Issuer-defined unit string. Should match unit declared in credential redemptionPolicy if present.

proof.description: W3C Data Integrity proof. Ed25519 signature by Verifier device key. Generated within TEE.

created.description: ISO-8601 datetime. Must equal envelope generatedAt.

verificationMethod.description: Verifier device key identifier. Resolves to Verifier device public key.

proofValue.description: Base58btc-encoded Ed25519 signature over canonicalised event JSON-LD.
